title: GLM-5.3
variant: exlr8 k2/k3/k4, KindlingAI's bit280 width manifest from release v0.7 (default; bit275 and home also ship), CONC 1/2/4/6/8 dial, spark-attic, busy guard, fp8 KV, MTP + DFlash2 drafting, SSD KV store, gr8 TP=4
summary: GLM-5.3 (full) on four DGX Sparks (GB10) with gr8 at TP=4: the kindlingai exlr8 release v0.7 (9e25c28a, mul1 weights), bit280 width manifest, 8 sessions at a 1,048,576-token pool with spark-attic, fp8 KV, MTP + DFlash2 drafting, SSD KV store, busy guard. v3.2 rows measured 2026-11-21 on gr8 97089b3; v3.2.1 pins gr8 v1.1.1 (stock + attic client), checked 2026-11-22; v3.3 runs gr8 v1.2.0 + #612 and #613 from gr8 main + the attic client (gr8:v120-attic-a1a4), 4 boots A,B,B,A vs v3.2.1 overnight 2026-11-24 to 25 (PT).
changelog: v3.3 (2026-11-25): engine moves to gr8 v1.2.0 (stock pin ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:v1.2.0@sha256:3de05aab8cda21fd5d6b4af89ccdba6ff5abdbd704729601fd348fa638ade9fd, ab2eb95f; the KindlingAI GLM-5.3 TP=4 work #582) plus two long-prompt fixes merged into gr8 main on 2026-11-24 PT: #612 d4af92d5 (batched page-table uploads) and #613 77e82fef (KV tail extended in place); plus the attic client f5e0bdc4; default image gr8:v120-attic-a1a4 (a build you make, README). KindlingAI, one team: Matt Mastracci @mmastrac, Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems, Steve @coffeedev / @coffee-the-dev and Albert Lee. Measured vs v3.2.1, 4 boots A,B,B,A, .env.example settings: cold 140,860-token prompt first token 104.12 -> 91.63 s (-12.0%); warm follow-up 5.23 -> 2.27 s (2.3x); SSD spills 3,370 pages a boot -> 0; lowest free memory a box at boot +0.80 GiB; smoke 14/14, panel 12/12, count-200, 128K needle, warm = cold pass on every boot. Trade (gr8 v1.2.0 #582 router change): 4-chat decode -4.1% cold / -5.2% warm (CIs cross zero), 4 short chats -2.4%, 8 short chats -0.2%, 1 chat -10.8% (CI -17.7% to +7.7%). Same weights, bit280, CONC rows and knobs.

v3.2.1 (2026-11-22): image pin moves to gr8 v1.1.1 (ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:v1.1.1@sha256:fa5c9f66fbfa55d162782578b3262893b782e6365a76562bcab951b54acc6d96, a3f44a0), KindlingAI's fix for garbled TP=4 output (#557); KindlingAI = Matt Mastracci @mmastrac, Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems and Steve @coffeedev / @coffee-the-dev (exlr8 quants since day one). Same settings and weights as v3.2. One boot: smoke, panel 12/12 (reply hashes unchanged), agent replay 24/24 + 20/20, matched-prompt C4 cold 101.5 (v3.2: 99.0), 9.1-10.3 GiB free a box under load; RigMark speed rows not re-measured.

v3.2 (2026-11-21): rebased on stock gr8 97089b3 (ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:sha-97089b3@sha256:717168f9afff1538c49383502e662fb45bd34d23630ac00f4d88fb1502b2fe4c), after gr8 v1.1.0 (tuned TP=4 kernels, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 TP=4 default, capacity-scaled CP sharding in RAM), engine, weights and bit280 manifest by Matt Mastracci @mmastrac and Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems, both KindlingAI; same weights (release v0.7 9e25c28a). CONC=8 pool 1,048,576 (was 950,272). One boot: 8 chats 173.5 tok/s total, 23.0 per chat (was 133.2); single chat code/prose/structured 61.7/39.7/79.7 (was 60.2/39.2/66.0); C4 like-for-like (v3 prompts, cold) 99.0 (was 96.1); 9.0-9.3 GiB free a box under load (was 5.4-5.7); prefill 8K 1,527.7 (was 1,554.7).

v3.1 (2026-11-21): the default dial moves to CONC=8 at a 950,272-token pool (was CONC=6 at 776,704), using the free memory v3 left on each box (5.4-5.7 GiB free under load, was 11.6-12.1). Same weights (release v0.7 9e25c28a, KindlingAI's bit280 manifest) and image (gr8 ca7e874) as v3, both by Matt Mastracci @mmastrac and Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems, KindlingAI. One boot: 8 chats 133.2 tok/s total (was 103.7), first token 0.39-0.41 s for all 8 (was 13.5 s for the 2 that waited), 1-4 chats level with v3; the v3 C4 110.2 row is corrected to a warm repeat (cold, same prompts: level).

v3 (2026-11-20): bit280 (KindlingAI's own v0.7 width manifest, ~2.80 routed bits per weight) on release v0.7 mul1 weights 9e25c28a; rebased on stock gr8 ca7e874 (ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:sha-ca7e874@sha256:d140aca32886d2055b7ff11d88c8860c6bb9c108c626f8f3a4f3cebdfe5fcfc6), weights and engine by Matt Mastracci @mmastrac and Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems, both KindlingAI; CONC 6 default (6 sessions at the 776,704-token pool with spark-attic, was 4); C4 110.2 tok/s total, 28.4 per chat (was 95.5); about 3 GB more free memory a box. One boot; see README "What is new in v3".

v2.1 (2026-11-15): the busy guard ships in the pinned stock gr8 image ghcr.io/kindlingai/gr8:sha-5625ed6@sha256:fdc662e2791b13e4d95ef2c6a8d8e6fd11f7f9b384c1d7d007fe76a9efc41c19 (PR #516, merge 5625ed6, proposed and merged by Matt Mastracci @mmastrac, KindlingAI, with his busy_view eviction-match and intake-hook fixes; pairs with the tiered KV store and session-keep design of Matt Mastracci @mmastrac and Chuck @ck2084 / @chuck-ads / @adapt-ai-systems, both KindlingAI). BUSY=1 needs no custom build: knobs.sh accepts the pinned image by digest or any image whose knob table carries GR8_BUSY_GUARD, and refuses an image without the guard. Recipe defaults when BUSY=1: BUSY_IDLE_SECS 120 (above a full back-to-back agent prefill; gr8 upstream 60), BUSY_RETRY_AFTER 20, BUSY_QUEUE_MAX 8.

v2 (2026-11-13): BUSY=1 busy-guard toggle documented (refuses a request that would evict a live session's KV, HTTP 429 + Retry-After, decided at intake; needs a gr8 image with the guard — github.com/bertholomus/gr8 branch busy-guard until the PR merges into kindlingai/gr8). Settings standard documented (layers, ./glm53 install, DRY_RUN). The SSD KV store becomes an opt-in tier (off by default); its measured numbers (~150 GB/h a box writes, 30/30 follow-up turns warm) ran keep=all on gr8 a555ee2 and are not re-measured on newer gr8 store work (#484, #498, #500, #501).
v1 (2026-11-11): public release prep of the bit275 recipe (scrub, MIT licence, d05aaec).
